# IPinfo: integration analysis

> Generated by API Integration Scout from <https://ipinfo.io/developers> on 2026-10-13T16:19:34.167Z.
> Every finding is marked **Documented** (quoted from the docs and verified), **Inferred** (the agent's reasoning) or **Not found in docs**.

IPinfo provides IP intelligence over a REST API: geolocation, ASN, anonymity/hosting/mobile flags, and more. Tiers are Lite (free), Core, Plus and Max, plus a batch endpoint and downloadable databases.

## At a glance

| Area | Finding | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base URL | https://api.ipinfo.io | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Authentication | bearer: Bearer token in the Authorization header. (+2 documented alternatives) | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Pagination | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Rate limits | Lite is unlimited. Paid plans have a monthly request quota. There are no daily, hourly, concurrency or per-second caps. | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Webhooks | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Error format | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Versioning | other | Inferred | [/developers/core-api](https://ipinfo.io/developers/core-api) |
| Endpoints | 6 found | 6 documented, 0 inferred | — |

## Risks

- **MEDIUM**: Two API generations. api.ipinfo.io and the legacy ipinfo.io host return different response shapes. Privacy Extended data is only available on the legacy shape, so pick one deliberately.
- **MEDIUM**: Plan gating. /lookup and the default /batch require a paid token. Free tokens must use /lite and /batch/lite.
- **MEDIUM**: Error format undocumented. The fetched pages show no error body schema, only the 429 status for quota overruns.
- **LOW**: Token in query string. The token query parameter can leak into logs. Prefer the Bearer header on the server side.
- **LOW**: Quota-based limits. Monthly quotas apply on paid plans, so watch usage or enable metered billing.

## Open questions

- What is the JSON error body for 401, 403 and 429 responses?
- Is there a formal versioning and deprecation policy for the legacy host?
- Which fields are plan-gated on Plus and Max, and what do their endpoints look like? Those pages were not fetched.
- Is there a limit on batch payload size beyond the 1,000-item cap?
